source.notes: Served by docs.relace.ai. Servers https://models.relace.ai (models) and https://api.relace.run (infra).

model.description: ID of the hosted model to use, e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` or `moonshotai/kimi-k3`.

messages.description: The conversation so far, as OpenAI-format message objects with `role` and `content`.

stream.description: If true, tokens are sent as server-sent events as they are generated. Token usage is always reported in the final chunk of the stream.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Reasoning tokens count toward this limit, so set a generous budget.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values make output more random.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only tokens within the top `top_p` probability mass are considered.

top_k.description: Only the `top_k` most likely tokens are considered at each step.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences at which generation stops.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens by how often they have appeared so far. Range -2 to 2.

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens that have appeared at all so far. Range -2 to 2.

repetition_penalty.description: Multiplicative penalty on repeated tokens. Values above 1 discourage repetition.

tools.description: OpenAI-format function tool definitions the model may call.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool use: `none`, `auto`, `required`, or a specific tool.

response_format.description: Set to `{"type": "json_object"}` for JSON mode. Kimi K3 only.

prompt_cache_key.description: Cache affinity key. Requests with the same key are served by the same server, improving cache hit rates for multi-turn sessions. Use a stable value per conversation or session. Compatible with OpenAI's parameter of the same name.

ChatCompletionsRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible request. Supported sampling parameters vary slightly by model.

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the completion was created

model.description: The model that served the request

message.description: The generated message, with `role` and `content` (and `tool_calls` when the model called tools)

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion

usage.description: Token usage information for the request

model.description: ID of the hosted model to use, e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` or `moonshotai/kimi-k3`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Reasoning tokens count toward this limit, so set a generous budget.

messages.description: The conversation so far, as Anthropic-format message objects with `role` (`user` or `assistant`) and `content` (a string, or an array of `text`, `image`, `tool_use`, `tool_result`, and `thinking` blocks).

system.description: System prompt, as a string or an array of `text` blocks.

stream.description: If true, the response is sent as server-sent events in the Anthropic streaming format. Token usage is reported in the `message_delta` event.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values make output more random.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only tokens within the top `top_p` probability mass are considered.

top_k.description: Only the `top_k` most likely tokens are considered at each step.

stop_sequences.description: Up to 4 sequences at which generation stops.

tools.description: Anthropic-format tool definitions with `name`, `description`, and `input_schema`. Server tools are ignored.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool use: `{"type": "auto"}`, `{"type": "any"}`, `{"type": "tool", "name": ...}`, or `{"type": "none"}`. `any` and a named tool require a model with forced tool choice; others are served as `auto`. Set `disable_parallel_tool_use` to limit the model to one call per turn.

thinking.description: `{"type": "enabled"}` or `{"type": "adaptive"}` turns reasoning on; `{"type": "disabled"}` turns it off. `budget_tokens` is accepted but not enforced.

output_config.description: `effort` (`low` to `max`) maps onto the model's reasoning effort levels where it has them. `format` is accepted and ignored.

user_id.description: Cache affinity key. Requests with the same value are served by the same server, improving cache hit rates for multi-turn sessions. Use a stable value per conversation or session.

MessagesRequest.description: Anthropic-compatible request. `cache_control` markers and other Anthropic-only fields are accepted and ignored. Supported sampling parameters vary slightly by model.

id.description: Unique identifier for the message, prefixed `msg_`

model.description: The model that served the request

content.description: The generated content blocks, in order: `thinking` (when reasoning is on), `text`, and `tool_use` (with the call's `id`, `name`, and parsed `input`)

stop_sequence.description: The matched stop sequence when `stop_reason` is `stop_sequence`; otherwise null

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens not served from cache

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from cache, billed at the Cached Input rate

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Always 0; writing to the cache is free

usage.description: Token usage information for the request

bearerAuth.description: Relace API key Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Relace API key in the `x-api-key` header, as the Anthropic SDKs send it. Accepted on `/v1/messages` only.
